Hi! 👋 I’m a girl who spends most of her time on the road — I travel across Europe and the UK in a truck 🚛 and film videos about it. I really do my best: I combine my main job with filming and editing 🎥, and sometimes it can be very exhausting.

To stay awake behind the wheel and have enough energy to keep recording, I drink a lot of coffee ☕. Honestly, I love it — so much that I could drink it all the time. I usually take drip bags with me so I can enjoy fresh coffee on the go, but I can’t carry too many, and it’s rare to find really good coffee on the road.

That’s why whenever I get the chance, I always stop to buy a good cup of coffee ☕✨.

If you’d like to support my vlog or treat me to a cup of coffee, I would be incredibly grateful ❤. Every new aromatic cup makes my journey warmer and me — a little happier 🌟.

☕ Support my coffee here:
👉 https://buymeacoffee.com/girltruckroutine

Guys, important message! 🚨

There are scammers who are using my profile picture, slightly changing my name, and messaging you pretending to be me. They leave phone numbers and ask you to contact them there, and then try to scam you out of money.

I NEVER ask for money in private messages and I NEVER contact people first with such requests. Any accounts like that are fake and are scams.

Please:
❌ Do not call or message those numbers
❌ Do not respond to them
❌ Block and report those accounts immediately 🚫

Stay safe and be careful ❤🛡
